ns0:problem.ns0:para: Determine whether each graph is the graph of a function.

ns0:media.alt: The figure has two graphs. In graph a there is a straight line graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x and y-axes run from negative 10 to 10. The line goes through the points (0, 2), (3, 0), and (6, negative 2). In graph b there is a parabola opening to the right graphed on the x y-coordinate plane. The x and y-axes run from negative 6 to 6. The parabola goes through the points (negative 1, 0), (0, 1), (0, negative 1), (3, 2), and (3, negative 2).

ns0:solution.ns0:para:
ⓐ Since any vertical line intersects the graph in at most one point, the graph is the graph of a function.
ⓑ One of the vertical lines shown on the graph, intersects it in two points. This graph does not represent a function.
